_doc: #284 (ADR 0006): this line is unplayable until ported; its cards are kept for the line's skill tests. A card is on offer to every job on the line of its requires.jobs (UpgradePool.on_line), weapons gate no card, and the carried-attack and advancement-draw rules below are gone. Pirate first-job cards (#186; B4 #416 deleted the cards of the five ported Brawler skills: the buccaneer pool generates theirs). Tier A: 20 canonical skill levels. Tier C: learn/rank weights 4/3 for attacks and 2/2 for Bullet Time; behaviour weight 2, +1 target or pierce per step, at most 3 steps. Shared Potential magnitudes apply; every card follows the weapon held at draw time. First-job cards stay on offer for both branches through requires.carry_jobs [510, 520] (spec #165 #180 shape): they list job 500 only in requires.jobs, so the advancement draw of a second job offers that branch's own skills, never the first-job ones. Second-job cards (#189: Improve MaxHP, Knuckler Mastery/Booster for the Brawler, Gun Mastery/Booster for the Gunslinger) require their exact branch and, through the skill, the matching held weapon family; they are not power cards; weights 2/2 and the 10/20 canonical ranks are tier A/C; magnitudes are the shared Potential table. Brawler attacks (#191: Backspin Blow, Double Uppercut, Corkscrew Blow): power cards that require the exact branch 510 and, through the skill, a held knuckle; learn 4, rank 3 (20 canonical levels), +1 target (count) weight 2, at most 3 steps, tier C untuned. Dash (#188): learn weight 2, rank weight 2 (10 canonical levels), no behaviour modifier; its cards follow the same carry_jobs shape. Untuned. Oak Barrel (#194, Brawler 510 only, requires exact job 510): learn weight 3, rank weight 2, max rank 10, neither a power card; tier C, untuned.
